$comment: Structured intake facts for the fictional Ridgeline sample, transcribed from intake-notes.md. Every item's source defaults to the file-level source and evidence below; a locator names the heading the fact sits under.

company.description: Residential and light-commercial HVAC service, replacement and maintenance, plus plumbing service added in 2019
company.founderBackground: Founded by Mark Delaney after 12 years as a lead technician at a regional HVAC contractor
company.serviceArea: Franklin, Delaware and Licking counties (about a 35-mile radius)

customerFacts.fact: 1,450 active maintenance-agreement members (two tune-ups a year, priority scheduling, 15% repair discount)
Commercial customers are property managers, small office buildings and 4 restaurant groups
Largest single customer is about 4% of revenue
Revenue mix FY2025: residential service and replacement about 64%, commercial about 27%, maintenance agreements about 9%

workforce.payBasis: Technicians are paid hourly plus spiff commissions on maintenance agreements

responsibilities.transitionSupport: Introduces commercial accounts during the transition

transition.description: Willing to stay up to 12 months for transition and to introduce commercial accounts

growthLevers.baseline: Agreements are offered on about 35% of service calls
growthLevers.mechanism: Offer the agreement on every service call; each new member adds two tune-ups a year and priority-scheduled repair work

growthLevers.baseline: Calls after 7 pm are turned away today
growthLevers.mechanism: Staff an on-call rotation so after-hours calls are served rather than turned away

growthLevers.baseline: Two property managers have asked for quotes on additional buildings
growthLevers.mechanism: Quote and sign the buildings already requested by existing property-manager customers
growthLevers.proofPoint: Two property managers have asked for quotes on additional buildings

growthLevers.baseline: Little paid digital marketing today; most leads are referrals and Google reviews
growthLevers.mechanism: Add paid search and local service ads on top of the referral and review base

growthLevers.lever: Second location in the Dayton market
growthLevers.mechanism: Open a second dispatch base to serve the Dayton market

reasonForSale.text: Owner retirement (age 61); the owner wants a clean exit within 12 months

notes.text: Prefers an asset sale; open to a buyer keeping the Ridgeline name and all employees

milestones.event: Became a Carrier Factory Authorized Dealer

revenueLines.label: Residential service and replacement
revenueLines.whatTheCustomerBuys: HVAC and plumbing repair, replacement and installation for homeowners

revenueLines.label: Commercial service
revenueLines.whatTheCustomerBuys: HVAC service and preventive maintenance for property managers, office buildings and restaurant groups

revenueLines.whatTheCustomerBuys: Membership: two tune-ups a year, priority scheduling and a 15% repair discount
